pages.name: Neo-Old Indian: 2.Bg5
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 called the g5-bishop light-squared and described a pin on an f6-knight that is not there; plan 3 played ...g5 onto the bishop. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3.

pages.name: Neo-Old Indian: 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5
pages.notes: Plan 3 described a 3...f6 gambit with ...Nf6, ...Bg7 and ...Rf8 that does not exist (the gambit here is 3...Nc6). Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Neo-Old Indian: 2.c4 e5 3.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 3 named Nxd4 before Black had taken; plan 4 attacked a d4-pawn that would be a knight; plan 2 called ...e4/...f5 King's Indian-like. Rewrote all four plans.

pages.name: Neo-Old Indian: Wade Defence, 3.c4 Nd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed the light-squared bishop to b7 with it already on g4; overview called ...Bg4 a pin (the e2-pawn blocks). Rewrote overview and plan 1. Reviewer rejection (...e6 cuts across the ...e5 plan) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Neo-Old Indian: Wade Defence, 3.c4 Nd7 4.Nc3
pages.notes: Plan 2 called h3 breaking a pin and played g4 onto the bishop; overview called ...Bg4 a pin. Rewrote overview and plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Neo-Old Indian: Wade Defence, 3.c4 Nd7 4.Nc3 e5
pages.notes: Plan 1 named White's h3 inside a Black plan and freed a bishop that is already developed; plan 2 broke a non-existent pin with e3. Rewrote overview and both plans. Reviewer rejection (Black does not fight for e4 here) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Neo-Old Indian: Wade Defence, 3.e4 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 4 named gxf3 and Qxf3 before Black had taken. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Old Indian Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 castled without ...Nf6; plan 4 developed Be2 with the e-pawn on e2. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Rat Defense: English Rat
pages.notes: Plan 1 named White's moves (dxe5, Qxd8+) and ...Kxd8 inside a Black plan; plan 3 suggested ...c5 or ...f6 instead of the thematic ...f5. Rewrote plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: Rat Defense: English Rat, Lisbon Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 recaptured ...Bxd6 before White had taken on d6 and wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.
